hint.en: Parameter 2: Select what type of Meter Reports will be sent when setting the parameter 101-103 to send the automatic reports.

label.en: Report power, report the absolute value of energy.
Report positive/negative power, report the algebraic sum of energy.
Enable/disable selective reporting only when power change reaches a certain threshold or percentage

hint.en: Parameter 3: Determines whether or not to limit reporting power changes to only report when the change is above the threshold.
Parameter 4: Determines the threshold change in wattage before an automatic report is send to Homey.

label.en: Wattage threshold for automatic reporting, Clamp 1

hint.en: Parameter 5: Determines the threshold change in wattage on Clamp 1 before an automatic report is send to Homey.

label.en: Wattage threshold for automatic reporting, Clamp 2

hint.en: Parameter 6: Determines the threshold change in wattage on Clamp 2 before an automatic report is send to Homey.

label.en: Percentage wattage threshold for automatic reporting

hint.en: Parameter 8: Determines the percentage threshold for wattage changes to trigger an automatic report.

label.en: Percentage wattage threshold for automatic reporting, Clamp 1

hint.en: Parameter 9: Determines the percentage threshold for wattage on Clamp 1 changes to trigger an automatic report.

label.en: Percentage wattage threshold for automatic reporting, Clamp 2

hint.en: Parameter 10: Determines the percentage threshold for wattage on Clamp 2 changes to trigger an automatic report.
Parameter 101: Determines the type of reports sent to devices in the 1st report group.
Parameter 102: etermines the type of reports sent to devices in the 2nd association group.
Parameter 103: Determines the type of reports sent to devices in the 3rd association group.
Parameter 111: Determines the interval for sending report to devices in report group 1.
Parameter 112: Determines the interval for sending report to devices in report group 2.
Parameter 113: etermines the interval for sending report to devices in report group 3.
